name: compartment_resistance_v1
description: Phase 5 post-MVP: Neftel-inspired compartments plus optional sensitive/persister/resistant axis. Research prototype only — not clinically validated.

assumptions: Resistance axis is a research construct only (sensitive/persister/resistant).
Induction/progression activate under kill pressure at fixed toy rates.
Kill multipliers are scenario research weights, not validated PK/PD.

scenarios.label: Baseline growth (no cytotoxic pressure)
notes: Baseline isolates growth/transition/resistance mix without kill pressure.

scenarios.label: Toy TMZ pressure
notes: TMZ pressure preferentially removes sensitive cells in this toy model.

scenarios.label: Toy TMZ + FUS delivery multiplier
notes: FUS is modelled only as a delivery multiplier (research toy).

assumptions: Compartment labels follow a Neftel-inspired MES/NPC/OPC/AC vocabulary for research alignment only.
Growth is discrete-time logistic with a shared carrying capacity.
Resistance subpopulations are optional and explicitly toy-parameterized.
Outputs are for in-silico hypothesis exploration only.

literature_anchors.note: Neftel et al. cell-state framework cited as vocabulary inspiration only.
